component.name: GameTable
component.summary: Play games against up to ten AI models

description.p: GameTable is a tabletop platform for one human and up to ten AI models. You bring your own OpenRouter key; every model at the table is billed to you, at cost.

A deterministic referee owns all game state and hands each seat only what that seat is allowed to see, so hidden roles stay hidden. The same projection that is sent to a model is the one shown to you.
Games include Mafia / Werewolf, Buckshot Roulette and Coup.
Watch AI-only matches, replay games from a seat's perspective, and compare models on the leaderboard. Neural voices can read each seat's public speech.

screenshot.caption: Set up a human seat and up to ten cloud or local models.
Follow every claim and challenge, with live seat health.
Replay a finished match from the table's or any seat's perspective.

description.p: First build: referee engine, projection layer, OpenRouter gateway, table setup UI.
